name: Astrahealth
description_en:
Astra Health is a medical AI scribe focused on clinical documentation, with workflows tailored to Australian primary care. It listens to consultations or dictation, drafts structured notes and helps produce letters, referrals and care plans for clinician review. It is a specialised clinical assistant, rather than a general personal notebook.

The documented workflow ends with a clinician editing and approving the draft before transfer to the medical record. Language coverage, integration access and privacy statements are vendor documentation, not independently tested clinical accuracy or compliance findings.
description_zh:
Astra Health 是面向临床文书的医疗 AI 记录助手，工作流尤其针对澳大利亚初级医疗。它从问诊或口述内容起草结构化笔记，并帮助生成信件、转诊单和照护计划，交由临床人员审核。它是专业临床助手，并非通用个人笔记本。

文档中的流程要求临床人员先编辑、批准草稿，再转入医疗记录。语言范围、集成条件与隐私声明来自厂商资料，不代表独立验证过临床准确率或合规结论。

core_features.explanation_en: Consultation capture or dictation produces a draft for clinician approval.
core_features.explanation_zh: 从问诊记录或口述生成草稿，由临床人员批准。

core_features.explanation_en: Generate notes, referrals, letters and care plans; each requires review.
core_features.explanation_zh: 生成笔记、转诊文书、信件及照护计划，均需审核。

core_features.explanation_en: Copy/download outputs; direct integration availability must be checked.
core_features.explanation_zh: 复制／下载输出，直连集成可用性需核对。

en: Draft a consultation summary for clinician approval.
Prepare a reviewed referral from consultation information.
zh: 起草问诊摘要供临床人员批准。
依据问诊信息准备经审核的转诊文书。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor account-based service alongside existing clinical systems.
Deployment.zh: 通过厂商账户服务配合现有临床系统。

steps.en: Create an account and choose a note style suitable for the specialty.
steps.zh: 创建账户并选择适合专科的笔记样式。

steps.en: Confirm consent and use a non-patient example to evaluate capture, edit and approval.
steps.zh: 确认同意要求，用非患者示例评估记录、编辑与批准。

steps.en: Confirm the target EMR/PMS export or integration before moving real records.
steps.zh: 转移真实记录前确认目标 EMR／PMS 的导出或集成方式。

items.en: Astra explicitly requires clinician review, editing and approval before AI documentation enters the record. Its terms require appropriate patient consent and lawful handling. For an incomplete recording or a misleading summary, the safe editorial recommendation is to correct against the encounter or rewrite the missing material before filing, rather than treating a generated document as evidence that everything was captured. No automatic recovery guarantee or diagnostic performance was established in this research.
items.zh: Astra 明确要求 AI 文书进入病历前由临床人员审核、编辑和批准。条款要求适当的患者同意与合法处理。若录音不完整或摘要有误，建议依据真实问诊更正或重写缺失内容后再归档，不能把生成了文书当作完整记录的证明。本次研究未确认自动恢复保证或诊断性能。

review_notes: Primary-source research is a draft, not publication, owner verification, price approval or independent review.
English and Chinese carry matching amounts, billing periods, qualifications and unknowns.
Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.title_zh: 从问诊到已批准的记录
sections.en: An illustrative consultation workflow is to select the appropriate note style, obtain the required consent, start consultation capture or dictation, then compare the generated summary with the actual encounter. Correct names, medication details, negations and follow-up instructions before approval. The FAQ says outputs can be copied, downloaded or integrated into an EMR/PMS; do not assume every destination has a direct connector.
sections.zh: 示例流程是选择合适的笔记样式、取得所需同意、开始问诊记录或口述，再把生成摘要与真实问诊核对。批准前应更正姓名、用药细节、否定表述和随访要求。FAQ 说明输出可复制、下载或集成至 EMR／PMS；不能假定每个目标系统都有直连连接器。

sections.en: The FAQ distinguishes structured clinical notes, referral letters, patient summaries and MBS-ready care plans. A note template captures encounter details; a referral transforms selected information for another clinician. Treat each document as a separate review surface. The website uses different language-coverage counts across pages, so confirm the actual input language, output language and template combination instead of promising a single universal language count.
sections.zh: FAQ 区分结构化临床笔记、转诊信、患者摘要和适配 MBS 的照护计划。笔记模板记录问诊细节，转诊文书则把选定信息转写给其他临床人员。每份文书都应单独审核。官网不同页面的语言数量表述不一致，因此需确认实际输入语言、输出语言和模板组合，不能承诺统一的通用语言数量。

sections.title_en: Clinician licences and a time-limited trial
sections.title_zh: 临床人员许可与限时试用
sections.en: The FAQ identifies the monthly price as AU$99 per clinician excluding GST. The pricing page lists 99 per month or 999 per year, excludes GST and adds 10% GST for Australian customers; enterprise pricing is custom. It advertises unlimited consultations/dictation and documents in those plans. New users receive a 14-day trial without a credit card. That is not evidence of a perpetual free tier; partner extensions require eligibility confirmation.
sections.zh: FAQ 明确月费为每名临床人员 99 澳元，未含 GST。定价页列出每月 99 或每年 999，均不含 GST，澳大利亚客户结账增加 10% GST；企业方案询价。页面把不限量问诊／口述和文书列入这些方案。新用户有无需信用卡的 14 天试用。这不能证明有永久免费套餐；合作伙伴延长试用需确认资格。

sections.title_en: Human review is part of the product workflow
sections.title_zh: 人工审核是工作流的一部分
sections.en: Astra explicitly requires clinician review, editing and approval before AI documentation enters the record. Its terms require appropriate patient consent and lawful handling. For an incomplete recording or a misleading summary, the safe editorial recommendation is to correct against the encounter or rewrite the missing material before filing, rather than treating a generated document as evidence that everything was captured. No automatic recovery guarantee or diagnostic performance was established in this research.
sections.zh: Astra 明确要求 AI 文书进入病历前由临床人员审核、编辑和批准。条款要求适当的患者同意与合法处理。若录音不完整或摘要有误，建议依据真实问诊更正或重写缺失内容后再归档，不能把生成了文书当作完整记录的证明。本次研究未确认自动恢复保证或诊断性能。

sections.en: Shortlist it for clinicians who want assistance drafting records alongside an existing EMR/PMS. It is a poor fit for autonomous medical decision making or generic team task management. The vendor describes privacy protections and local storage arrangements for Australian/New Zealand users; this research did not audit infrastructure or legal compliance. The FAQ also mentions a separate integration plan, so obtain the exact connector scope and commercial terms before changing a clinic workflow.
sections.zh: 需要在现有 EMR／PMS 旁辅助起草病历的临床人员，可将其列入候选。自主医疗决策或通用团队任务管理不符合此定位。厂商说明了隐私保护以及澳大利亚／新西兰用户的本地存储安排；本次没有审计基础设施或法律合规。FAQ 还提到单独的集成方案，因此改变诊所流程前应取得明确的连接器范围与商业条款。

research_gaps.en: No clinical recording or accuracy test, compliance audit, connector execution or contract-specific residency/retention review was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未做临床录音或准确率测试、合规审计、连接器执行或合同层面的驻留／保留核查。

research_gaps.en: Exact supported language combinations and integration-plan fees remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 确切支持的语言组合与集成方案费用尚未核实。
